mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_operation_log (project_id, operator_id, target_user_id, previous_role_id, new_role_id, operation_type, detail, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{operatorId}, #{targetUserId}, #{previousRoleId}, #{newRoleId}, #{operationType}, #{detail}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select l.log_id as logId, l.project_id as projectId, l.operator_id as operatorId, l.target_user_id as targetUserId, l.operation_type as operationType, l.detail as detail, l.create_time as createTime, operator_user.user_name as operatorName, target_user.user_name as targetUserName from pm_project_operation_log l inner join pm_project_member access_member on access_member.project_id = l.project_id and access_member.user_id = #{userId} left join sys_user operator_user on operator_user.user_id = l.operator_id left join sys_user target_user on target_user.user_id = l.target_user_id where l.project_id = #{projectId} order by l.create_time desc, l.log_id desc
